people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: John answered, “A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.
translations.bsb: John replied, “A man can receive only what is given him from heaven.
translations.kjv: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.
